landmarks.name: Victoria Memorial
landmarks.hint: A grand white marble monument built in memory of Queen Victoria, now a museum in the Maidan

landmarks.name: Howrah Bridge
landmarks.hint: A cantilever bridge over the Hooghly River, one of the world's busiest, connecting Kolkata and Howrah

landmarks.name: Indian Museum
landmarks.hint: The oldest and largest museum in India, founded in 1814, with priceless collections on natural history and art

landmarks.name: Kalighat Temple
landmarks.hint: One of the 51 Shakti Peethas, this temple dedicated to Goddess Kali gave Kolkata its name

landmarks.name: Eden Gardens
landmarks.hint: One of the world's oldest and largest cricket stadiums, home to the Kolkata Knight Riders

landmarks.name: Science City
landmarks.hint: One of the largest science centres in South Asia, with space science, evolution and dynamotion halls

landmarks.name: Fort William
landmarks.hint: A large British colonial fort on the east bank of the Hooghly, still an active military base

landmarks.name: St. Paul's Cathedral
landmarks.hint: The first episcopal church in Asia, built in Gothic style with a steeple modelled on Canterbury Cathedral

landmarks.name: Birla Planetarium
landmarks.hint: One of the largest planetariums in Asia, built in 1963 in the shape of a Buddhist stupa

landmarks.name: Belur Math
landmarks.hint: The headquarters of the Ramakrishna Math and Mission, its unique architecture blends Hindu, Islamic and Christian motifs
